messages:
Maria: Heads-up — since 2026-03-19 14:23 UTC we saw a sudden jump in billed tokens for /api/v1/generate on prod after enabling strict typed-tool validation. Fallbacks to the legacy toolchain spiked ~4x. Anyone else seeing this?

Jamal: Yep, noticed the same. Console shows a rise in `invoke_fallback` events but no sample payloads to debug. Just counts.

Lena: I pulled logs from the runtime:
```
ERROR validation: schema_mismatch: expected object at tools.signature.args.summary; got string
router: routing_decision=FALLBACK -> model=gpt-lite-2
```
Happened ~1200 times in 10m window for route `chat-prod`.

Priya: Was the routing policy for that route set to cost-first? If so fallbacks going to cheaper model would still bill tokens but degrade quality; that can explain cost bump.

Owen: Confirmed: route config has `routing.policy=cost_then_latency`. When strict validation rejects, it triggers fallback_path which uses `fallback_model: cheapest_compatible`.

Maria: Two problems: (1) we lack context for why validation fails (need sample or sanitized snippet) (2) fallbacks are invisible in console except counts. Need better telemetry + UX.

Jamal: Minimal ask: add `validation.reason` tag to the metric and keep a single latest failed sample per route behind a click. Sample capture should be opt-in/org-level because of PII.

Lena: Agreed. Also propose sampling at 0.5% by default and add a sanitization hook before storing payloads.

Priya: UX needs: a per-route toggle "capture validation samples" + retention info and clear PII warning. Also a toggle to set `soft_validate` (log-only) for a rollout window.

Owen: Soft validate would be hugely useful: treat validation failures as events (no fallback) so we can measure failure modes without changing runtime behavior. Could add `validation.soft_fail=true` in route config.

Maria: Example route snippet (proto-config):
```
route: chat-prod {
  routing.policy: cost_then_latency
  validation: { mode: strict, soft_fail: true }
  fallback: { model_selector: cheapest_compatible }
  telemetry: { sample_rate: 0.005, redact: "pii/v1" }
}
```

Jamal: For metrics: we should emit `validation_check` with tags: route, model, decision=[accept|reject], reason=[type], fallback_target, cost_delta_tokens. Then a derived `fallback_cost_delta` gauge per-minute.

Lena: I'll draft event schema. Basic fields: `event_name=validation_check`, `route`, `model`, `decision`, `reason`, `payload_hash`, `sanitization_level`. Keep payload off by default.

Priya: Console panels: 1) Validation -> Fallback rate (trend) 2) Top reasons for rejects 3) Estimated token cost delta from fallbacks (+confidence) 4) Quick sample link (if enabled) with redaction summary.

Owen: Also add an alert: when `fallback_cost_delta` > 20% sustained for 5m, page oncall with metadata + link to sample (if enabled).

deploy-bot: canary deploy v2.3.1 to eng-prod completed (2026-03-19T14:40:12Z)

Maria: Important: sampling/sanitization must be in the runtime path (before routing) to avoid shipping raw PII to backend. We should only log hashes and redacted text unless org explicitly opts in.

Jamal: Ops note: if teams use `soft_fail` during canary, set it per-slice. We should expose a rollout tag `validation.soft_fail=true` in console rollout UI so SEs can toggle by slice.

Lena: Action items:
- Lena -> draft telemetry schema + sample retention policy (ETA: EOD) 
- Owen -> prototype `soft_validate` flag and runtime noop path (ETA: 2d)
- Jamal -> dashboard panels + alert (ETA: 1d)
- Priya -> console UI toggles for capture + soft_fail (ETA: 3d)

Maria: Sounds good. Also: add a quick smoke test to the e2e harness to simulate a validation fail and ensure fallback cost delta is captured.

Owen: I'll add test to canary job.

Priya: One more: add a short copy for the console explaining privacy and how to enable samples — legal needs that.

Maria: Thanks. Ping here when you have the telemetry draft so we can align on dimensions. :thumbsup: 

Lena: Will post schema and an example event in this thread when ready.
